description: Add backend ProgrammeHandler tests - currently at 0% coverage. Test GetProgramme and ListProgrammes with temp directory and sample JSON files.
steps: Create backend/internal/api/programme_test.go following the exact patterns in files_test.go (httptest.NewRequest, httptest.NewRecorder, t.TempDir).
Add a helper setupProgrammeDir(t) that creates a temp dir with seconde.json, premiere.json, terminale.json containing minimal valid JSON programme data.
Test GetProgramme: valid niveau=seconde returns 200 + JSON content. Invalid niveau returns 400. Missing niveau param returns 400. Non-existent file returns 404.
Test GetProgramme with lang=en: create a seconde.en.json, verify it is served. If .en.json does not exist, verify fallback to FR version.
Test GetProgramme with .programmes/ subdirectory fallback: create the JSON in a .programmes/ subfolder, verify it is found.
Test ListProgrammes: returns 200 with JSON array of 3 niveaux (seconde, premiere, terminale).
acceptance_criteria: backend/internal/api/programme_test.go exists with at least 6 test functions
go test ./internal/api/ -count=1 passes with no failures
Tests cover: valid request, invalid niveau, missing param, 404, lang fallback, ListProgrammes
